title: Min cost climbing stairs
statementMd:
`cost[i]` is the price to step off stair `i`; you may start at index 0 or 1 and climb 1 or 2 steps. Return the minimum cost to reach the top (just past the last index).

**Example:** `min_cost_stairs([10, 15, 20])` returns `15`.
hints: Roll the two last best costs.
